item.title: Video: Fireball engulfs newlywed woman during honeymoon at Darjeeling homestay
item.description: A honeymoon in Darjeeling turned tragic for a newlywed couple from Chopra. The wife sustained severe burn injuries during a barbecue incident at a homestay. Her husband bravely fought the flames engulfing her, as shown in a video. Relatives allege the homestay authorities delayed crucial medical assistance for the victim. The woman remains in critical condition while police investigate the incident.
item.dc:creator: ROSHAN GUPTA

item.title: Meet Dina McCormick, whom Zuckerberg asked to trade her Meta board seat for a job
item.description: Born in Cairo, Egypt and raised in Texas, Dina Powell McCormick gave up her Meta board seat last December after Mark Zuckerberg asked her to take an operating job instead. Nine months on, the Goldman Sachs veteran and former deputy national security adviser is president, vice chairman and co-leader of Meta Compute, handling the company's hardest legal, political and financial problems as its 2026 AI capex guidance climbs to as much as $145 billion.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Parthiv frontrunner for chief selector if Agarkar, BCCI fail to agree extension
item.description: Parthiv Patel is a strong candidate to lead the men's senior selection committee if Ajit Agarkar's tenure is not extended by the BCCI. Key figures have discussed Patel as a potential successor for the job. Agarkar's recent absence from a review meeting had further fueled speculation.
item.dc:creator: SAHIL MALHOTRA

item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Lokayukta police trap GST official with Rs 8 lakh bribe
item.description: A Central GST official was apprehended by Lokayukta police for accepting a bribe. The superintendent demanded twenty lakh rupees from a businessman to close a tax evasion case. He agreed to accept eight lakh rupees and used an agent for the transaction. The businessman reported the demand, leading to the trap and arrests of both men. Both the official and his agent were sent to judicial custody following the operation.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Charlie Puth’s $4.17m Montecito home sells for $18.5m nine years later
item.description: In a noteworthy real estate move, Charlie Puth has divested his Montecito estate for a stunning eighteen point five million dollars, significantly higher than his 2017 acquisition cost of four point one seven million dollars. This charming residence holds cherished memories, including his marriage to Brooke Sansone two years ago. This transaction showcases Puth's impressive financial progression, complementing his recent California property sales.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: 14 years after Austin Tice vanished, new betrayal may reveal what happened
item.description: Austin Tice, a journalist, disappeared in Syria in 2012 while covering the civil war. New BBC findings suggest his driver betrayed him to the Syrian regime for rewards. Confidential intelligence files indicate the Syrian government detained Tice after his alleged abduction. His mother maintains he is alive and being treated well by his captors. The US government continues its active investigation and offers a reward for his return.
item.dc:creator: TIMESOFINDIA.COM

item.title: iPhone buying guide: iPhone 18 Pro vs iPhone Duo vs iPhone 17, which one to buy
item.description: Apple's iPhone lineup in India now runs from Rs 79,900 to Rs 2,99,900, and the newest model is no longer the obvious buy. The 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max arrive with variable aperture and the A20 Pro, the foldable iPhone Duo lands in October, and there is no new standard model this year. Here is what each iPhone gives you, who it suits, and which ones to walk past.
item.dc:creator: ABHINAV KAUSTUBH

item.title: Meet Ishtiaq Ali, 85, who carves Hindu gods on living trees without harming them
item.description: Ishtiaq Ali, an 85-year-old artist, carves Lord Ganesha onto a living tree. His unusual method and dedication have garnered significant social media attention. He spent decades working daily wage jobs before finding purpose in his art. Ali explains the significance of making idol eyes last and the trunk's direction. This Muslim artist's work showcases his deep understanding of Hindu deities.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Supermarket sold expired Chocos; consumer court orders Rs 10,182 payout to customer
item.description: A consumer commission ordered Vishal Mega Mart to refund a customer Rs 182 for an expired food product. The retailer also must pay Rs 10,000 for compensation and litigation costs. The customer had purchased the expired item on December 1, 2025, and received no response. Vishal Mega Mart denied deficiency in service and unfair trade practices. The commission found the retailer guilty of selling an expired product to the complainant.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: NSE’s mega IPO crosses full subscription mark with strong institutional demand
item.description: The National Stock Exchange of India's IPO saw full subscription on its second day. Strong demand from institutional investors drove the significant subscription levels. Qualified Institutional Buyers and non-institutional investors showed robust interest in the offering. The IPO is an entirely an offer for sale, with proceeds going to selling shareholders. NSE shares are expected to debut on the market on September twenty-fourth.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Watch: Songs, car rally as men back accused in Gurgaon woman biker hit-and-run case
item.description: Men rallied in cars supporting Kalyan Singh Bainsla, accused in a Gurgaon hit-and-run incident. Bainsla allegedly chased and rammed a biker, Shivani Chauhan, on Golf Course Road. Investigators are reconstructing the events and questioning associates present during the incident. The accused were taken to the spot for a sequence of events reconstruction. A local court had sent Bainsla and an associate to police custody.
item.dc:creator: NIKHIL SHARMA

item.title: Anu chases podium: After 'paper bronze' in 2018, Japan offers redemption
item.description: At 33, Anu Raghavan has survived Rio heartbreak, financial uncertainty and personal loss. Now, armed with data, belief and one final shot, India's 400m hurdler returns to the Asian Games chasing the moment she was denied eight years ago.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: India’s Chef de Mission admits accommodation crisis, reveals additional rooms booked
item.description: India's Chef de Mission acknowledged the struggle with accommodation shortages at the Asian Games. Following a reduction in their allocated rooms, the Indian contingent successfully secured more hotel spaces. Additionally, challenges arose from transport and accreditation logistics, which compounded the difficulties. An unexpected delay also affected the flag-hoisting ceremony, but India's focus continues to be on ensuring the comfort and performance of its athletes throughout the Games.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Sebi warned on digital gold in 2025; now physical backing and oversight in works
item.description: The finance ministry has sought feedback from regulators, banks and other stakeholders. A broad consensus has emerged that digital gold should be classified as a security under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: 'Nothing against sportsman spirit': Pakistan explain decision to boycott Israel
item.description: Pakistan refused to play Israel in the opening round of the 2026 Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, handing Israel a 4-0 walkover. Pakistan’s chess federation said the decision followed the government’s policy of not recognising Israel and was also meant to show solidarity with Palestinians. Officials stressed the boycott was about state policy, not the players or sporting spirit.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: Air India Express ordered to pay Rs 27K after bicycle put on baggage belt
item.description: A consumer commission ordered Air India Express to refund a fee. The airline mishandled a passenger's bicycle despite special handling payment. The commission found deficiency in service after the bicycle appeared on the regular belt. Air India Express must now pay compensation and litigation costs to the passenger. The total amount ordered to be paid is Rs 27,000.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: ‘Clear message’ for Hardik: Gambhir reveals what he must do to return to Team India
item.description: India's coach Gautam Gambhir emphasised that Hardik Pandya needs to improve his match fitness before rejoining the national squad. Playing in upcoming games, including potential matches for India A, will be crucial for Pandya to restore his form. Additionally, the team is focusing on Nitish Kumar Reddy's growth as a seam-bowling all-rounder, aiming for a roster that offers versatility for future competitions.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: One win from history: India’s Quimcy Dsouza storms into Teqball semis at Asian Games
item.description: Quimcy Joaquim Dsouza has advanced to the semifinals of Teqball after a gripping comeback victory over Japan's top seed Yuina Sakamoto. Following this, she showcased her skills by securing a decisive win against Cambodia's Koemyean DY. This outstanding performance not only cements her place in the semifinals but also positions her for a potential historic medal for India, where she will challenge Indonesia's Ima Sumaya next.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Raped, stabbed, body dumped: Delhi teen goes to meet friend, he calls 3 others
item.description: A 16-year-old girl was raped and murdered in Swaroop Nagar, Delhi. Four youths, including three minors, were apprehended by police in connection. Investigators are verifying the suspects' claims about their involvement in the crime. Forensic evidence and recovered weapons are being examined by the dedicated team. The tempo used in the incident has also been seized by authorities.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: ‘Body kept in car for 7 hours’: How a Gurgaon meeting ended in HR professional’s murder
item.description: A 31-year-old HR professional was allegedly murdered after meeting a former colleague. Police arrested the former colleague, Anya Vats, and her partner, Sanyam Sachdeva. Investigators suspect a financial dispute led to the alleged killing of Yuvraj Singh Manchanda. The couple reportedly confessed to dumping the body in a sewer near their home. They were apprehended in Uttarakhand after fleeing the scene.
item.dc:creator: ABHAY

item.title: Punjab: ASI shot dead, 2nd attack on a cop within a week
item.description: An Assistant Sub-Inspector of Punjab Police was fatally shot while on patrol. Unidentified assailants opened fire on ASI Harjit Singh near Bhagtawala Grain Market. The Chief Minister announced an ex-gratia payment of one crore rupees for the family. This killing follows recent attacks on police personnel in Punjab. Investigations are underway to identify those responsible for the shooting.
item.dc:creator: YUDHVIR RANA

item.title: MP shocker: Man attacks wife at hospital for ‘birthing daughter’
item.description: A shocking incident unfolded in Gwalior where a man was arrested for allegedly attacking his wife in a hospital ward post-childbirth. This violent act occurred after the woman welcomed twins, including a baby girl. The victim's family argues that the assault highlights underlying gender bias. Reports from the hospital revealed a fierce argument before the physical confrontation. Police are now probing the circumstances and the injuries involved.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Rajkot man kills 5-year-old daughter, stores body in fridge; ends life
item.description: A father allegedly murdered his five-year-old daughter in Rajkot due to financial difficulties. He then placed her decorated body inside the refrigerator before taking his own life. Preliminary investigations and suicide notes pointed towards severe financial distress from a construction project. The man had also invested personal loan money into the ill-fated construction site. Police are examining the circumstances surrounding the tragic events in the village.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: A month before Gurgaon hit-and-run case, men chased, harassed Bhopal biker
item.description: In Bhopal, biker Abida Rana encountered a troubling situation when two men in a car relentlessly pursued her on Nabibagh Road. They blocked her path for several hundred meters, prompting Abida to document the incident on her Instagram later. Authorities intervened, warning the men at the police station. Ultimately, Abida chose not to file a criminal complaint, and no FIR was lodged.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Vizag woman visiting techie son in Melbourne dies after car crashes into Porsche
item.description: A heartbreaking incident struck a Visakhapatnam family in Australia, where a tragic car crash resulted in the instant deaths of two women, Neha and Rama Devi. The collision occurred at a Melbourne intersection when their vehicle collided with a Porsche on Wednesday evening. Authorities are currently investigating the details surrounding this fatal accident that has left the local Indian community and the mourning family in deep sorrow.
item.dc:creator: SIVA G

item.title: Abhishek Sharma reveals Yuvraj's message after scoring record-breaking century
item.description: Abhishek Sharma smashed a record 30-ball century against Afghanistan after receiving advice from mentor Yuvraj Singh to avoid forcing shots and rotate the strike. He scored 102 as India posted 221/7 and won by 127 runs. Abhishek finished the three-match series with 229 runs, including two centuries, responding strongly after facing pressure following a difficult Zimbabwe series.
item.dc:creator: JYOTIRMOY HALDER

item.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' BO Day 15 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi film eyes Rs 205 cr India net mark
item.description: ‘Mirzapur The Movie’ has entered Day 15 of its theatrical run after crossing the Rs 200 crore mark in India. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer has collected Rs 203.63 crore India net so far. With its worldwide gross at around Rs 292 crore, the Gurmmeet Singh directorial is now within striking distance of the Rs 205 crore domestic and Rs 300 crore worldwide milestones.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
